status: NORMATIVE append-only request error precedence clarification; no implementation or runtime acceptance
scope: This rule resolves only request-parameter error precedence. All43 frozen files, schemas, packet fields, A/B/C data and expected vectors remain byte-exact. No API name, reason enum, successful result, source rule or packet-field error classification changes.
request_admission_order: Require a well-formed argument object with exactly the method's declared keys; missing required record_id or extra keys gives invalid_argument/invalid_schema at the empty root JSON Pointer, message Invalid onboarding request. No parameter lookup or source I/O occurs.

For list_onboarding_records, apply existing defaults for omitted optional parameters, then validate kind, query, limit, offset in that order. Each named parameter's existing reason takes precedence over generic invalid_type or invalid_schema, including wrong builtin type, subclass, encoding, enum and range failures. After those checks and filtering, an out-of-result-set offset also uses invalid_offset.
For get_onboarding_record, validate the supplied record_id before exact lookup as below. No lookup happens on invalid input; no path/URL is ever interpreted or opened.

get_record_id.invalid: Not a plain builtin str, empty string, or not strictly UTF8-encodable: code invalid_argument, reason invalid_type, path /record_id, message Invalid onboarding request. No coercion, callback, trimming or lookup.
get_record_id.admissible: Any nonempty plain builtin UTF8-encodable string proceeds to exact packet-local lookup without trimming, aliasing, normalization or interpreting the value as a path/URL. This includes whitespace-only strings, leading/trailing whitespace, punctuation, path-like and URL-like values; they are not automatically syntax failures.
get_record_id.matched: Return the unchanged existing full record plus diagnostics, subject to the unchanged result bounds. No parameter admission or lookup grants permissions or executes source/workflow content.

unchanged_packet_rule: Generic wrong primitive packet-field types still use invalid_packet/invalid_type, except already frozen specific packet constraints. This addendum gives list request parameters priority only; it does not reinterpret packet fields or weaken strict UTF8/schema/source validation.
preserved_oracles: EXPECTED-REQUEST-VECTORS.json remains unchanged: true/list/null/etc for each list parameter uses its existing invalid_kind, invalid_query, invalid_limit or invalid_offset. Exact nonempty unknown IDs retain unknown_record. All original independent and author source/query/paging/get oracles remain required.
safe_errors: Every error remains exactly the existing four-field object code/reason/path/message, with fixed messages and no raw request, identifier, source content, file path or underlying exception echoed. Existing graph/context contracts remain unchanged.
authorization: Finite root-authorized contract clarification only. No reader/provider/server/SDK/test/model execution and no public or tag-candidate writes. Independent prospective receiving and separate root body authorization remain required.
